name: Kahlua Hot Chocolate
desc: Spiced stovetop cocoa spiked with Kahlua and topped with marshmallows and caramel.

source.title: Kahlua Hot Chocolate
source.evidence: Same ingredients (2 cups milk, 2 tbsp sugar, Dutch-processed cocoa, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, a dash of nutmeg, Kahlua off the heat) and the same marshmallow, caramel and chocolate syrup toppings.

steps: Whisk the sugar, cocoa, cinnamon and nutmeg together in a small saucepan.
Gradually whisk in the milk. Cook over medium heat, whisking, until steaming and the cocoa is fully dissolved, 2 to 3 minutes (longer if the milk starts cold). Do not let it boil.
Remove from the heat and stir in the Kahlua.
Pour into 2 mugs, top with marshmallows, and drizzle with caramel sauce and chocolate syrup.
tips: Starting from cold milk, Taste of Home heats it 5 to 7 minutes; go by the steam, not the clock.
Taste of Home uses 2 to 4 tbsp (1 to 2 oz) Kahlua for 2 servings if you want it stronger.
Add the Kahlua off the heat so the alcohol does not cook off.
